scientific_limits: Joint linear readout and low-rank adaptation are standard components, not a claim of method invention or identified causal mechanism. This is a new controlled current-M8/DINOv3-L scope experiment. Prior ViT-B/M5 joint nonlinear/normalization/augmentation studies already exist. Repeated development exploration is optimistic; fresh group partitions are not a new external cohort and paired intervals omit full fitting/selection uncertainty.
